intro.name: Jan Tokic
intro.title: Software Engineer
intro.bio: I'm a software engineer from Austria, based in Munich. I build fast, reliable systems from trading engines to large-scale web apps. Co-founded Mira Trading and Copile, and now work with Elevantiq on high-volume e-commerce systems.

elevantiq.description: Architected order processing at scale. Improved throughput by about 45% with async queues, smarter caching, and tighter SQL. Systems handle millions of transactions each month.

mira.description: Built a high-frequency Solana trading bot in Go. Automated token launches and real-time execution. Reached 8,000+ trades per month and ~$230K profit in five months.

copile.description: B2B crypto trading platform used by 2,100+ clients. Real-time API across five exchanges processing about €1.2M in monthly volume.

ibm.description: Vue.js headless commerce storefront with 85,000+ SKUs. Cut promo rollout time for enterprise clients by about 40%.

connect.heading: Let's Connect
connect.description: I'm available for freelance projects and consulting. Whether you need high-performance systems, blockchain integration, or scalable infrastructure—let's build something exceptional.
